section.content: 本实用新型涉及生物工程技术领域，且公开了一种用于生物基因工程的生物培养箱，包括箱体，箱体为矩形箱体，且箱体的内部为空心，箱体的下壁面固定安装有两个镜像对称的底撑块，本实用新型中，在使用时，当该箱体上的过滤网板在长时间使用后，这时便可以将过滤网板拆卸下来进行更换清洗，首先将螺帽与螺纹进行拧松，这时便可以取出过滤网板，更换后便可以进行安装，且安装时还是与拆卸步骤相通，将更换后的过滤网板放置在两个弹簧上，这时再将活动盖进行旋转挤压过滤网板，使过滤网板挤压两个弹簧进入收集盒内部，这时活动盖会通过自身孔洞贯穿固定杆，再通过螺帽将活动盖固定在连接块上即可，从而达到方便拆卸更换的效果。

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological engineering, and discloses a biological incubator for biological gene engineering, which comprises a box body, wherein the box body is a rectangular box body, the interior of the box body is hollow, two mirror symmetry bottom support blocks are fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the box body, when in use, after the filter screen plate on the box body is used for a long time, the filter screen plate can be disassembled for replacement and cleaning, firstly, a nut and a screw thread are unscrewed, then the filter screen plate can be taken out, the filter screen plate can be installed after replacement, and the disassembly step is communicated during installation, the replaced filter screen plate is placed on two springs, then, a movable cover is rotated to extrude the filter screen plate, so that the filter screen plate extrudes two springs to enter the interior of a collecting box, at the moment, the movable cover can penetrate through a fixed rod by the movable cover, and then the movable cover is fixed on a connecting block by the nut, thereby achieving the effect of convenient disassembly and replacement.

Biological incubator for biological gene engineeringTechnical Field

The utility model relates to a bioengineering technical field especially relates to a biological incubator for biological gene engineering.

Background

Biological culture refers to the rapid growth and propagation of some organisms by means of artificially prepared culture media and artificially created culture conditions, and is called biological culture. The biological culture can be divided into pure culture and mixed culture, wherein the former means culture and utilization of purified single strains; the latter means that the variety and quantity of organisms in the soil can be estimated to a certain extent according to the variety and quantity of organisms growing on the culture medium after culturing organisms in mixed strains or natural samples (such as soil), the culture medium is required for organism culture, and a specific culture medium is prepared according to different varieties and living habits of the organisms. The key to the success of biological culture lies in aseptic operation, and if culture instruments and culture media cannot be sterilized completely, and the culture process is easily failed due to mixed bacteria pollution.

The biological incubator who commonly uses is in order to satisfy the required air of biological growth, consequently can have seted up the air vent on the incubator, still need filter and purify the air simultaneously to avoid polluting, however the used device of current filtration purification is very inconvenient when dismantling the change, and we propose a biological incubator for biological genetic engineering.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

Technical problem to be solved

The utility model mainly solves the technical problems existing in the prior art and provides a biological incubator for biological gene engineering.

(II) technical scheme

In order to achieve the above purpose, the utility model adopts the following technical scheme, a biological incubator for biological gene engineering, comprising a box body, wherein the box body is a rectangular box body, the interior of the box body is hollow, two bottom supporting blocks with mirror symmetry are fixedly arranged on the lower wall surface of the box body, each bottom supporting block is in a circular block shape, the upper wall surface of the box body is provided with a ventilation groove which is in a rectangular groove shape, a collecting box is arranged inside the ventilation groove, the collecting box is in a rectangular box shape, the collecting box is hollow, the lower wall surface of the collecting box is in a hollow shape, the left side wall surface and the right side wall surface of the collecting box are movably jointed with the left side wall surface and the right side wall surface inside the ventilation groove respectively, the left side wall surface and the right side wall surface of the collecting box are fixedly provided with connecting blocks respectively, the connecting blocks are in a rectangular block shape, the lower wall surfaces of the two connecting blocks are movably connected with the upper wall surface of the box body respectively, collect the inside bottom side wall fixed mounting of box have two mirror symmetry's spring, the inside of collecting the box is provided with filters otter board, two the upper end of spring respectively with filter otter board's lower wall swing joint, the last wall fixed mounting of box has the fixed block, and the fixed block is rectangular block, the square groove has been seted up on the fixed block, the square inslot portion on the fixed block is provided with the movable cover, and the movable cover is the rectangle apron, the round hole has been seted up to the upper wall of movable cover, the opening has been seted up to the upper wall of movable cover, and the opening is the rectangle groove form, the square inslot portion on the fixed block is provided with the hinge.

Preferably, the movable cover is movably connected with the front side wall face and the rear side wall face of the inside of the square groove on the fixed block through a hinge, a fixed rod is fixedly mounted on the upper wall face of the left connecting block of the collecting box and is in a circular rod shape, the fixed rod penetrates through the movable cover, threads are formed in the outer wall face of the fixed rod, and nuts are connected to the outer wall face of the fixed rod through threaded threads.

Preferably, the antetheca of box is provided with the operation screen, four equidistance staggered arrangement's square groove is seted up to the antetheca of box, and the square groove is the rectangle groove form, every both sides wall fixed mounting respectively has the second spring about the inside of square groove.

Preferably, the two square grooves above the operation screen are internally provided with upper sliding covers, the two square grooves below the operation screen are internally provided with lower sliding covers, and the upper side wall surface and the lower side wall surface of each upper sliding cover are respectively movably connected with one end of each two groups of second springs, which are close to each other.

Preferably, the upper side wall surface and the lower side wall surface of the lower sliding cover are respectively movably connected with one end, close to each other, of each two groups of second springs, the second square grooves are respectively formed in one side wall surface, close to each other, of the lower sliding cover and the upper sliding cover, the second square grooves are rectangular groove-shaped, and one side, close to each other, of the upper sliding cover and the lower sliding cover is open.

Advantageous effects

The utility model provides a biological incubator for biological gene engineering. The method has the following beneficial effects:

(1) when the biological incubator is used, after the filter screen plate on the box body is used for a long time, the filter screen plate can be detached to be replaced and cleaned, firstly, the screw cap and the screw thread are unscrewed, the screw cap is taken out of the screw thread, then, the movable cover can rotate without the fixation of the screw cap, at this time, the movable cover rotates to the right side of the fixed block and can be taken away from the filter screen plate, at this time, the filter screen plate can automatically pop out under the rebounding of two springs in the collection box, at this time, the filter screen plate can be taken out to be replaced, the filter screen plate can be installed after being replaced, and the installation is communicated with the detachment step, the replaced filter screen plate is placed on the two springs, at this time, the movable cover is rotated to extrude the filter screen plate, so that the filter screen plate extrudes the two springs to enter the collection box, at this moment, the movable cover can penetrate through the fixed rod through the hole of the movable cover, and the movable cover is fixed on the connecting block through the screw cap, so that the effect of convenient disassembly and replacement is achieved.

(2) After the filter screen plate is arranged in the collection box, the movable cover can extrude the filter screen plate into the collection box when in installation, when external wind power enters the box body through the ventilation groove, the wind power firstly passes through the filter screen plate for filtering, then the gas enters the box body through the collection box, and when the filter screen plate receives the wind power, the filter screen plate also moves, when the filter screen plate is extruded towards the inside of the collecting box by wind power, the filter screen plate rebounds under the rebounding of the spring and collides with the lower wall surface of the movable cover, the dust and impurities filtered on the filter screen plate can be shaken, the inner part of the collecting box can be cleaned when the filter screen plate is detached and replaced, so that the effect of automatically cleaning dust and impurities on the filter screen plate is achieved.

(3) This a biological incubator for biological genetic engineering, the preceding wall swing joint of box has last sliding closure and lower sliding closure, and go up sliding closure and lower sliding closure activity joint inside the square groove, go up the upper and lower both sides wall face of sliding closure and lower sliding closure and carry out the joint with the inside second spring of square groove respectively, when external force touching or striking the position of operation screen, at this moment go up the sliding closure and the lower sliding closure and just can the intercrossing removal from top to bottom after receiving the contact, make the impact that goes up the sliding closure and slide down and cover cushion and offset, thereby reach the effect of protecting this operation screen.

The utility model discloses a theory of operation: when the box body is used for a long time, the filter screen plate 7 on the box body 1 can be detached for replacement and cleaning, the screw cap 13 and the screw thread 12 are firstly unscrewed, the screw cap 13 is taken out of the screw thread 12, the movable cover 9 can rotate without the fixation of the screw cap 13, the movable cover 9 is rotated to the right side of the fixed block 8 and is taken away from the filter screen plate 7, the filter screen plate 7 can be automatically popped out under the rebounding of the two springs 6 in the collecting box 4, the filter screen plate 7 can be taken out, the filter screen plate 7 can be replaced, the filter screen plate 7 can be installed after replacement, the installation is communicated with the detachment step, the replaced filter screen plate 7 is placed on the two springs 6, the movable cover 9 is rotated to extrude the filter screen plate 7, and the filter screen plate 7 extrudes the two springs 6 to enter the collecting box 4, at this moment, the movable cover 9 can penetrate through the fixed rod 11 through the hole of the movable cover, and then the movable cover 9 is fixed on the connecting block 5 through the screw cap 13, so that the effect of convenient disassembly and replacement is achieved.

When the filter screen plate 7 is arranged in the collecting box 4, the movable cover 9 can extrude the filter screen plate 7 into the collecting box 4 when in installation, when external wind power enters the box body 1 through the ventilation groove 3, the wind power firstly filters on the filter screen plate 7, then the gas enters the box body 1 through the collection box 4, and when the filter screen plate 7 receives the wind power, the filter screen plate 7 moves, when the filter screen plate 7 is pressed towards the interior of the collecting box 4 by wind power, the filter screen plate 7 rebounds under the rebounding of the spring 6 to collide with the lower wall surface of the movable cover 9, at this time, the dust and impurities filtered on the filter screen plate 7 can be shaken, when the filter screen plate 7 is detached and replaced, the interior of the collecting box 4 can be cleaned, so that the effect of automatically cleaning dust and impurities on the filter screen plate 7 is achieved.

The front wall face swing joint of box 1 has last sliding closure 17 and lower sliding closure 18, and go up sliding closure 17 and the movable joint of lower sliding closure 18 inside square groove 15, go up the upper and lower both sides wall face of sliding closure 17 and lower sliding closure 18 and carry out the joint with the inside second spring 16 of square groove 15 respectively, when external force touches or strikes the position of operation screen 14, at this moment go up sliding closure 17 and lower sliding closure 18 and just can the intercrossing of upper and lower after receiving the contact and move, make the impact on last sliding closure 17 and the lower sliding closure 18 cushion and offset, thereby reach the effect of this operation screen 14 of protection.
